blocks.heading: Custom Development Services *to Power Your Business Growth*
blocks.lead: We build scalable, high-performance websites and web apps that load fast, rank well, and turn visitors into customers.

header.title: Everything from *simple to complex*
header.subtitle: Whatever your digital presence needs — we build it right, the first time.

items.title: Custom Website Design
items.body: Pixel-perfect, brand-aligned designs that make a lasting first impression. Every page is crafted to guide visitors toward a clear action.

items.title: Web App Development
items.body: Complex, feature-rich applications built with modern frameworks like React and Next.js. Scalable architecture, clean APIs, and real-time capabilities.

items.title: Landing Pages
items.body: High-converting landing pages engineered to capture leads and drive sales. A/B tested layouts, fast load times, and clear conversion paths.

items.title: E-commerce Stores
items.body: Full-stack online stores with Shopify, WooCommerce, or custom solutions. Seamless checkout, inventory management, and payment gateway integration.

items.title: CMS Integration
items.body: Headless WordPress, Contentful, or Sanity setups so your team can update content independently — no developer needed for day-to-day changes.

items.title: Performance Optimisation
items.body: Core Web Vitals tuning, image optimisation, CDN configuration, and caching strategies to keep your site blazing fast on any device.

header.title: How we *deliver*
header.subtitle: A clear, collaborative process that keeps you informed at every stage.

items.title: Discovery & Strategy
items.body: We dive deep into your goals, audience, and competition. You leave the discovery call with a clear roadmap and realistic timeline.

items.title: Design & Prototyping
items.body: Wireframes, UI mockups, and interactive prototypes — reviewed and approved by you before a single line of code is written.

items.title: Development & QA
items.body: Clean, semantic code built to modern standards. Rigorous cross-browser and device testing before anything goes near production.

items.title: Launch & Support
items.body: Smooth deployment with zero downtime. Ongoing support plans available so your site stays updated, secure, and fast post-launch.

header.title: Tools we *master*
header.subtitle: We choose the right technology for your project — not the trendiest one.

items.title: SEO & GEO
items.body: Drive traffic to the site we build for you

items.title: Business Automation
items.body: Automate the workflows behind your site

blocks.heading: Ready to build something *great?*
blocks.body: Book a free 30-minute call. We'll scope your project and give you a clear plan — no sales pitch, no obligation.

seo.metaDescription: Custom websites, web apps, landing pages and online stores built with React, Next.js and WordPress: fast, SEO-ready, and launched in 2–6 weeks.
